def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - (bins > 0) * (bins - 1e-9)
    remaining = np.maximum(remaining, 0)
    scores = remaining / (item + 1e-9)
    # Adjust score to penalize bins that are close to full relative to their capacity
    normalized_load = bins / (bins.sum() + 1e-9)
    penalty = 1 - normalized_load
    scores *= (1 + penalty)
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - (bins > 0) * (bins - 1e-9)
    remaining = np.maximum(remaining, 0)
    gap = remaining - item
    gap = np.maximum(gap, 0)  # Only consider bins that can fit the item
    scores = gap / (item + 1e-9)
    return scores

    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    remaining = np.maximum(remaining, 0)
    normalized_load = (bins - remaining) / (bins + 1e-9)
    # Reward bins with moderate remaining capacity (not too full, not too empty)
    # Use a linear penalty based on deviation from ideal remaining capacity (0.3 to 0.7 of bin capacity)
    ideal_min = 0.3
    ideal_max = 0.7
    lower_deviation = np.maximum(ideal_min - remaining / (bins + 1e-9), 0)
    upper_deviation = np.maximum(remaining / (bins + 1e-9) - ideal_max, 0)
    deviation = lower_deviation + upper_deviation
    priorities = 1 / (deviation + 1e-9)
    # Set priority to 0 if bin cannot accept the item
    priorities[remaining == 0] = 0
    return priorities
